name: Dead Campus Atlas records
description: Curated campuses, coded institutions, and federal closure sites as one table with two levels (kind = institution | site).

layers.extended: Institutions whose campus closed, coded from public pages with evidence URLs.
layers.coded: Institutions coded but not drawn: still operating, merged with the campus continuing, not a closure, or unresolved.
layers.federal: Federal closure sites, and institutions known only from them.

columns.name: record_id
columns.description: Stable id. Curated and extended records keep their page ids; sites use fsa-NNNNN; others use ipeds-<unitid>, opeid-<root>, or coded-<unitid>.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: institution or site.

columns.name: parent_id
columns.description: For a site, the record_id of its institution. Empty for institutions.

columns.name: layer
columns.description: Richest layer an institution belongs to: curated, extended, coded, or federal. A site is always federal.

columns.name: institution_layer
columns.description: For a site, the layer of its institution, so sites can be filtered without a join.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Institution or site name.

columns.name: city
columns.description: City.

columns.name: state
columns.description: State or territory code.

columns.name: state_reported
columns.description: State as written in the federal file, where curation/federal-corrections.json changed it.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Country, where the federal file records a foreign location. Empty for U.S. records.

columns.name: zip
columns.description: ZIP code (sites).

columns.name: address
columns.description: Street address (sites).

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Latitude. Sites: Census batch geocoder. Institutions: curated coordinates or IPEDS.

columns.name: longitude
columns.description: Longitude.

columns.name: coordinate_source
columns.description: census-geocoder, ipeds, or curated.

columns.name: unitid
columns.description: IPEDS UNITID.

columns.name: opeid
columns.description: 8-digit OPEID of the site.

columns.name: root_opeid
columns.description: 6-digit root OPEID, the institution-level federal key.

columns.name: branch_suffix
columns.description: Two-digit OPEID branch suffix (sites).

columns.name: site_type
columns.description: Main/Root or Branch/Satellite (sites).

columns.name: federal_classification
columns.description: Atlas preliminary class from the federal file (sites).

columns.name: federal_source_url
columns.description: Source page of the federal report (sites).

columns.name: ipeds_match
columns.description: How a site was joined to IPEDS: opeid, root, location, or empty.

columns.name: control
columns.description: Sector: Public, Private nonprofit, Private for-profit.

columns.name: degree_granting
columns.description: 1 if degree-granting.

columns.name: ipeds_status
columns.description: active, closed, combined, dropped, or empty when not in IPEDS 2000-2024.

columns.name: ipeds_first_year
columns.description: First year in the IPEDS directory.

columns.name: ipeds_last_year
columns.description: Last year in the IPEDS directory.

columns.name: successor_name
columns.description: For a combined institution, the institution it was combined into.

columns.name: federal_sites
columns.description: Institution: number of federal closure sites.

columns.name: federal_main_sites
columns.description: Institution: main/root sites.

columns.name: federal_branch_sites
columns.description: Institution: branch and annex sites.

columns.name: federal_first_closure_year
columns.description: Institution: earliest federal closure year.

columns.name: federal_last_closure_year
columns.description: Institution: latest federal closure year.

columns.name: coding_tier
columns.description: curated, sample, or census: how the fate was established.

columns.name: outcome
columns.description: closed-campus-reused, closed-campus-unknown, merged-campus-continues, merged-campus-closed, still-operating, not-a-closure, unresolved.

columns.name: closure_date
columns.description: Closure date. Sites: federal report. Institutions: coded or curated.

columns.name: closure_year
columns.description: Closure year.

columns.name: transfer_date
columns.description: Date the campus changed hands, where established.

columns.name: campus_fate
columns.description: One sentence on what happened to the campus.

columns.name: buyer_name
columns.description: Who holds or operates the campus now.

columns.name: buyer_sector
columns.description: Controlled vocabulary of buyer sectors.

columns.name: replacement_system
columns.description: Controlled vocabulary of replacement systems.

columns.name: original_system
columns.description: Controlled vocabulary of original systems.

columns.name: morphology
columns.description: Morphology class, derived from the replacement system.

columns.name: zone
columns.description: Replacement zone on the territory map.

columns.name: confidence
columns.description: high, medium, or low.

columns.name: coding_notes
columns.description: Caveats from the coder.

columns.name: evidence_count
columns.description: Number of evidence pages.

columns.name: evidence_urls
columns.description: Evidence page URLs, separated by ' | '.

columns.name: rechecked_on
columns.description: Date of the second-pass check, where one was done.

columns.name: recheck_verdict
columns.description: confirmed (first coding stands), revised (fields changed), or unresolved.

columns.name: recheck_changed
columns.description: Fields the second pass changed, separated by ' | '.

columns.name: recheck_note
columns.description: What the second pass checked and found.

columns.name: duplicate_of
columns.description: record_id of a curated record sharing this institution's campus.

columns.name: summary
columns.description: Visitor-facing summary (curated only).

columns.name: verification
columns.description: Verification state from the controlled vocabulary (curated only).

columns.name: atlas_priority
columns.description: Iconic or Important (curated only).

columns.name: scale
columns.description: Scale, e.g. acreage (curated only).

columns.name: buyer_type
columns.description: Buyer type (curated only).

columns.name: sale_price
columns.description: Reported sale price (curated only).

columns.name: transformation
columns.description: Interpretive transformation line (curated only).

columns.name: events
columns.description: Dated status events: 'date TYPE: label', separated by ' | ' (curated only).

columns.name: limbo_days
columns.description: Days from closure to first completed transfer (curated only).

columns.name: editorial_note
columns.description: Editorial note where a source cuts against the classification (curated only).

columns.name: source_urls
columns.description: Curated source URLs, separated by ' | ' (curated only).

columns.name: process_source
columns.description: SHEEO, or Atlas coding where this project applied the SHEEO scheme to a for-profit exit the file does not cover.

columns.name: process_event
columns.description: closure, consolidation, merger, still-operating, or unresolved. SHEEO rows are all closures.

columns.name: process_confidence
columns.description: Confidence of an Atlas coding: high, medium, or low. Empty for SHEEO rows.

columns.name: closure_announced
columns.description: Date the closure was announced, from the SHEEO closed-college file.

columns.name: lead_time_days
columns.description: Days from announcement to closure. Empty where the announcement date is unknown or falls after the closure.

columns.name: abrupt_closure
columns.description: SHEEO coding: 1 abrupt, 0 orderly. Empty where not coded.

columns.name: teach_out
columns.description: Teach-out plan in place: yes, no, unclear, or n/a (abrupt).

columns.name: merger_attempt
columns.description: 1 if SHEEO records an attempted or executed merger, 0 if it records none.

columns.name: merger_note
columns.description: SHEEO text on the merger or acquisition, as written.

columns.name: peps_merge
columns.description: Merge or consolidation designation in the federal file.

columns.name: records_custody
columns.description: Where student records went, from SHEEO: yes, no, or other.

columns.name: accreditors
columns.description: Accrediting agencies in the federal file, separated by ' | '.

columns.name: sheeo_note
columns.description: Researcher note from the SHEEO file, as written. Researcher names and working remarks are left in.

columns.name: sheeo_sources
columns.description: Source URLs listed in the SHEEO file, separated by ' | '.

columns.name: sheeo_date_differs
columns.description: SHEEO closed date, where it differs from the federal closed date.

columns.name: sheeo_sites
columns.description: Institution: number of its federal sites that appear in the SHEEO file.

columns.name: peak_year
columns.description: Year of peak fall enrollment.

columns.name: peak_enrollment
columns.description: Peak fall enrollment.

columns.name: last_enrollment_year
columns.description: Last year enrollment was reported.

columns.name: last_enrollment
columns.description: Enrollment in the last reported year.

columns.name: decline_pct
columns.description: Percent decline from peak to last reported year.

columns.name: deficit_years_of_last_five
columns.description: Years in the last five reported with expenses above revenue.
